newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurd rebel leader in call to Turkey for dialogue.
newsitem.headline: Kurd rebel leader in call to Turkey for dialogue.

text.p: Kurdish rebel leader Abdullah Ocalan has renewed a call to Turkish authorities for dialogue on bringing the conflict in southeast Turkey to an end, according to a text of his televised comments.

"We are ready for dialogue, we have alternatives. There must at last be a Turkish and Kurdish political solution," Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) leader Ocalan said by telephone in a MED TV programme broadcast on Sunday evening. The text was obtained by Reuters on Monday.
Turkey has not responded to similar calls by Ocalan in the past on the Kurdish-language MED TV, which broadcasts from Europe by satellite and is banned in Turkey for being a tool of the PKK.
More than 22,000 people have died since 1984 in the PKK's armed struggle with Turkish security forces for self rule in the mainly-Kurdish southeast of the country.
